Affine.description: Evaluated affine transform, not author rotation/flip/viewport semantics.

linear.description: Dimensionless Q32 in row-major order: xx, xy, yx, yy.

translation.description: Q32 in the same coordinate unit as the input point.

linear.description: Nonnegative outward bounds, raw dimensionless Q32.

translation.description: Nonnegative outward bounds, raw Q32 EMU.

BlendMode.description: Porter-Duff composition, separate from the source brush and geometry mask.

oneOf.description:
Immutable full-viewport pixels before draw `after_draws`, after group
boundaries at that position. Device-aligned; path/view transforms do not
move it. Scope selects a canvas, never an implicit host resource.

ByteLength.description: Canonical uint64 byte length. Range requires semantic validation.

ClipNode.description:
Evaluated intersection path; geometry has its own transform. Parent clipping
remains in world coordinates and is never transformed by a child or draw.

applications.description: Actual pushes when preserving common ancestors between consecutive draws.

placementCommands.description: All supplied clip path commands checked during device placement.

capturedBytes.description: Exact packed pixel bytes copied for all snapshots; not process RSS.

DrawScene.description: Evaluated resources/instances, independent of authoring document semantics.

opacityGroups.description: Intervals refer to instances; lowering preserves their order and count.

EllipticGradientWork.description: Maximum across elliptic fields; excludes pixel coverage and shader inverse arithmetic.

coordinateErrorBound.description:
Conservative device Q32 displacement of corresponding ellipse-family
points from parameter/plane conversion, including the tile phase budget.

encodedRootIntervalBound.description:
Q32 width of a successful solver enclosure for the encoded binary32
field. Not a bound on the source field's scalar or on pixel color.

parameterErrorBounds.description:
Dimensionless Q32 source uncertainty plus binary32 conversion error,
ordered scaleX/Y, centerX/Y, radiusX/Y.

Emu.description: Signed int64 EMU. 1 point = 12700 EMU. Range requires semantic validation.

ExactMotion.description:
Position offsets in fractions of the slide width/height. Ratios encode the
computed position exactly; the frame profile states any path approximation.

ExactRotation.description:
An exact angle with its document dependency still explicit. The layout
orientation is resolved only at placement, after source inheritance.

ExactScale.description: Scale values remain thousandths of a percent until the placement boundary.

ExactValue.description: Output-only exact reduced ratio. Units are defined by each property channel.

commands.description: Local Q32 EMU; open contours are implicitly closed for filling.

FixedQ32.description: Signed i128 integer divided by 2^32. Coordinate unit is specified by the owning geometry profile; semantic range validation required.

motion.description: Exact slide-relative offsets from the original layout center.

opacity.description: Exact whole-object opacity in [0, 1], before one render-boundary rounding.

stops.description:
Nondecreasing positions in [0,1]. Repeated positions are hard stops.
Missing endpoint positions extend the first/last color to that endpoint.

oneOf.description:
First closed ellipse membership for q=((2u-1)*scaleX,(2v-1)*scaleY).
At t=0 the ellipse has innerCenter and innerRadii; at t=1 it is the
unit circle at the origin. Non-nested families use the first entry.

uncertainty.description:
Nonnegative Q32 errors ordered scaleX/Y, centerX/Y, radiusX/Y.
They bound geometry parameters, not a uniform scalar/color error.

oneOf.description:
t = coefficients[0] * u + coefficients[1] * v + coefficients[2].
u,v are the independently tiled/clamped coordinates in [0,1].

uncertainty.description: Nonnegative dimensionless Q32 errors, before float conversion.

oneOf.description:
Maximum of four inward edge fields and zero. Rates are ordered left,
top, right, bottom; a zero rate disables that edge. Positive rates give
1-u*left, 1-v*top, 1-(1-u)*right and 1-(1-v)*bottom respectively.

Office's endpoint-pair RGB curve, exponent 15/8; alpha stays linear.
Requires two endpoint stops or a symmetric three-stop ramp, straight alpha.

origin.description: World Q32 EMU position of the unit tile's top-left corner.

xStep.description: World displacement for a unit change in each tile coordinate.

origin.description: Nonnegative Q32 world EMU error per input parameter.

srgb.description:
Straight sRGB working channels. Finite RGB may exceed [0,1]; alpha must
be in [0,1]. No RGBA8 quantization is performed before interpolation.

origin.description: World Q32 EMU position of source pixel boundary (0, 0).

sourceDomain.description:
Optional continuous source pixel domain; may extend beyond the resource
into transparent space. Coordinates are Q32 pixels, not world EMU.

uncertainty.description:
Outward errors from upstream layout/placement. These participate in the
same device budget as float conversion, including repeated tile phase.

xStep.description: World Q32 EMU displacement per source pixel, not endpoint coordinates.

origin.description: Nonnegative Q32 world EMU errors; rebase never changes these bounds.

sourceDomain.description:
Nonnegative Q32 source pixel errors, left/top/right/bottom. Must be zero
when the brush has no explicit source domain.

xStep.description: Nonnegative Q32 world EMU per source pixel.

affine.description: Already evaluated into page space; do not apply parent placements again.

anchor.description: Subtract this exact source center before applying the evaluated affine.

sourceSize.description:
Shape/picture/connector bounds are local 0..size; custom paths and groups
use their own viewport. The current author model has no child offset.

uncertainty.description:
Covers author scale/angle computation and final Q32 quantization. It is
additional to mo-render's bounds for an already-quantized affine graph.

OpacityGroup.description:
Render the complete interval onto transparent pixels, then source-over it
onto its parent with a single opacity. This is not per-paint alpha.

endDraw.description: Exclusive, and strictly greater than first_draw.

opacity.description: 0 is transparent; 65535 is opaque. Linear coverage of premultiplied sRGB.

peakPixelBytes.description: Peak simultaneously live intermediate pixels, excluding output/snapshots.

pixelWork.description: Pixels cleared plus pixels composited, including fully transparent groups.

object.description: None denotes the page background. Groups create spaces, not paint draws.

surfaces.description: Master, layout, slide contexts; not a resolved paint or placeholder list.

raster.description: Reduced device tolerance reserves the explicit author/geometry budgets.

authorCoordinateErrorBound.description: Raw Q32 pixels, including author matrix quantization at control points.

authorMiterLimitErrorBound.description:
Author percentage -> Draw IR conversion, dimensionless raw Q32.
Separate from device miter quantization and pixel coordinate budgets.

geometryCoordinateErrorBound.description: Raw Q32 pixels: curve approximation + control-coordinate quantization.

combinedCoordinateErrorBound.description: All three stages, in raw Q32 pixels; not a raster coverage error bound.

brush.description: Already evaluated world-space paint, independent of this path transform.

stroke.description: Evaluated world-width stroke; not transformed by the geometry matrix.

numerator.description: Positive rational pixels per EMU; normalized internally.

objects.description:
Stable author order, groups followed by their descendants. A group entry
is a coordinate-space record, not a paint instruction.

PlaybackGeneration.description: Canonical uint64 playback generation; never wraps.

planId.description:
Content identity for this implementation profile, not an authority token
or a portable serialized-plan compatibility promise.

PlaybackTimingInfo.description:
Read-only diagnostics. Counts successful timing evaluations, including those
followed by a page/raster failure; does not count published or displayed frames.

oneOf.description:
A new page owner with time zero and an empty input prefix. Previous does
not synthesize a terminal pose or guess clicks on an unbounded timeline.

An eligible page condition admitted this event, including delayed work.
This remains consumed even if a later event cancels that scheduled work.

No eligible page condition admitted this event. The presentation host
may cross the requested boundary, using this kernel-defined entry state.

PresentationStepReceipt.description:
The last presentation step in the sampled, validated event prefix. The
enclosing frame binds document/session/generation and hashes this receipt.

frameSha256.description: SHA-256 of the little-endian device batch; use together with profile.

background.description: Straight sRGB RGBA8; output is premultiplied.

origin.description: Q32 EMU. Subtracted before converting to device-space float32.

coordinateErrorBound.description:
Conservative maximum error of the transformed control coordinates,
measured in raw Q32 pixels. Not a raster coverage error bound.

ellipticGradients.description: Only present for V12 ellipse fields. Geometry and solver errors are separate.

gradientCoordinateErrorBound.description: Device geometry input quantization, not a bound on shader evaluation or pixels.

gradientValueErrorBound.description:
Maximum stop/color conversion or linear/rectangular field error.
Elliptic parameter and root bounds are reported separately.

miterLimitErrorBound.description: Dimensionless raw Q32; not added to pixel coordinate budgets.

strokeWidthErrorBound.description: Width quantization, in raw Q32 pixels; not an ink boundary error bound.

RationalTime.description: Exact wire representation. Equality compares author values; compare_time compares instants.

combinedCoordinateErrorBound.description: Transform + final device quantization, raw Q32 pixels.

loweringAttempts.description:
2 means the shared matrix candidate failed numeric/precision checks and
lowering used the original node chain before any backend call.

pointTransformWork.description: Conservative point/node work per attempt, including identity instances.

transformErrorBound.description: Quantization/composition error bound, raw Q32 document units (EMU).

position.description: Zero-based cursor. The child count denotes the position after the end.

SnapshotScope.description:
The source canvas at a capture point. Explicit captures may be consumed
later in any group; their pixels remain immutable after the source closes.

oneOf.description: Legacy local capture: use must stay in its original innermost group.
Root output, excluding any unmerged active group surfaces.
Zero-based opacity-group index; must be active at the capture point.

Limit 1..=1024, dimensionless Q32. Clip perpendicular to the exterior
bisector at half-width * limit. Exact reversals use a bevel join.

width.description: Q32 page/world EMU. Zero explicitly requests a device hairline.

Ticks.description: Signed int64 ticks. Range requires semantic validation.

schedulesBuilt.description: Successful timeline samples only. Downstream page/raster work may fail.

TimelineWorkCount.description: Canonical uint64 timeline work count; never wraps.

parent.description: Optional outer transform. Parents must precede children.
